snippet.title: Abyss Drifter — Official Trailer | First-Person Space Courier Sim
snippet.description:
No autopilot. No waypoints. Nobody coming to help.
Wishlist Abyss Drifter on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4553500/Abyss_Drifter/

Abyss Drifter is a first-person space courier sim set in a star system that lost contact with Earth after AI was banned. You haul cargo between planets and stations, and almost nothing is hidden behind a menu: you refuel by hand at the hatch, make breathable air from ice you're carrying, seal off compartments to stop wasting it, patch your own hull, and land by reading your instruments.

In the game so far:
- Hand refuelling — station nozzle or emergency fuel barrels
- Oxygen generated from ice, controlled compartment by compartment
- Suits with their own oxygen, water and power
- Survival: hunger, thirst, fatigue, radiation and nutrition
- Hull damage, with field welding or a full drone repair at the station
- Instrument-based flight and landing
- A trading economy: open exchange, freight contracts, faction reputation, shops and recycling

Release date: TBA. A playable demo is in development.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4553500/Abyss_Drifter/
Discord: https://discord.gg/xn6REEmjPK
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/abyssdrifter_official?igsi=NTNxN3htOHZ4bGp2&utm_source=qr
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@abyssdrifterofficial?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc

Making your own video? Raw footage and the press kit are free to use, monetised or not: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1_Kyq-dbKXXkH4vTHxcpdwIK7kdI3WWRz?usp=drive_link
